credits.title: The First Gokturk
credits.overview: Part one in the epic Göktürk Trilogy follows the humble beginnings of the greatest empire Asia had ever seen.

credits.title: The First Gokturk: Prologue
credits.overview: This rebellion, which began with Bumin, Istemi, and his mentor Alagar, will write the epic of a people who broke their chains and re-emerged on the stage of history.

credits.title: Aile Çıkmazı
credits.overview: The story of a 4,000-year-old statue found by Turkish academics Şevket and Perihan during excavations in Egypt, which was stolen after being handed over to Egyptian authorities, and its journey from Egypt to Istanbul.
